title: Abdominal Quadrants and Nine Regions
author: OpenStax
caption: Nine abdominal regions and four abdominal quadrants of the peritoneal cavity used to localize abdominal trauma, tenderness, and peritoneal signs.
alt_text: Anatomical diagram showing (a) nine abdominal regions and (b) four abdominal quadrants on the human anterior abdomen.
clinical_relevance: Anatomical localization of blunt and penetrating abdominal injury, tenderness, and peritoneal signs (CLIFF-001 Branch Baseline, p.1).
